Rajasthan Police and Army Intelligence Bust Counterfeit Uniform Racket

Army intelligence units and Rajasthan Police seized approximately 1,000 meters of unauthorized combat cloth in Sriganganagar, Rajasthan. The operation, conducted on July 30, uncovered a racket supplying counterfeit army-pattern fabric. A local firm was identified as a supplier in this wider network distributing fake military uniforms. The seizure occurred near the India-Pakistan border.
